title: Business Development Executive
description:
Hybrid role in St Albans

About reallymoving
reallymoving is the UK s leading comparison platform for home-moving services, connecting customers with trusted Conveyancers, Surveyors and Removal Companies. As a digital marketplace, we generate high-intent customer leads and provide partners with real commercial value.

Purpose of the Role

We are looking for a motivated and commercially driven Business Development Sales Executive to join reallymoving. This role is ideal for candidates at an early stage of their career, or with some sales experience, who want to build a long-term career in business development.

As a Business Development Sales Executive you ll be responsible for identifying and engaging prospective partners, such as conveyancers, surveyors and removal companies, helping them access high-intent customer leads through our platform and generate new revenue for their business. You will work across a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound enquiries, using a consultative approach to build relationships and demonstrate the value of our platform.

You will be working towards clear and achievable monthly targets across outreach, pipeline development and partner conversion.

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 2 days per week attendance in our central St Albans office, a short walk from St Albans City station. You will also attend company team days, occasional ad-hoc meetings, and travel for face-to-face partner meetings when required.

Key Responsibilities
- Generate partner leads: Identify and research prospective partners using directories, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, networking and trade events.
- Prospect proactively: Conduct outbound sales activity through calls, email, LinkedIn and other channels to create new opportunities.
- Handle inbound enquiries: Respond promptly to inbound leads and convert them into new partners.
- Qualify and understand needs: Build a strong understanding of potential partners businesses and commercial drivers to position our proposition effectively.
- Present solutions: Communicate the value of reallymoving s lead generation platform clearly and persuasively.
- Build relationships: Establish strong relationships with prospective partners and act as a professional first point of contact.
- Manage pipeline: Build and maintain a strong pipeline, progressing opportunities through to conversion.
- Track performance: Work towards defined monthly targets across activity, pipeline and conversion.
- Manage CRM: Maintain accurate records of all activity and interactions.
- Share market insight: Provide feedback to improve proposition, campaigns and commercial approach.

What You Will Bring
- A good standard of general education, including strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident communicator with the ability to build rapport quickly and act as a professional first point of contact.
- Motivated, resilient and proactive, with a strong interest in sales, working with KPIs and targets, and driving commercial outcomes.
- Comfortable using LinkedIn, AI tools and CRM systems.
- Well organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple leads and enquiries.
- Willing to attend trade events, network externally and work collaboratively with internal teams.
- Be comfortable working with our company values: Customer obsessed: Ambitious: Humble: United: We re people people

Why Join?

You ll join a supportive, high-performance sales environment where strong results are recognised and rewarded and where you ll gain valuable experience working with stakeholders and cross functional teams across the business, with opportunities to develop and progress your career over time.

What to expect from our recruitment process
- Virtual HR competency-based interview with the HR Manager 60 minutes.
- Face-to-face interview with the Head of Sales 60 minutes.
- Final face-to-face interview with the Head of Sales and Chief Growth Officer 90 minutes.

Reallymoving is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We recognise the benefits of a diverse workforce which reflects the wider population and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor employment visas at this time and can therefore only accept applications from candidates who have permanent Right to Work in the UK or indefinite leave to remain.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Location: St Albans, Hertfordshire
Department: Business Development & Marketing
Contract: Full-time, Permanent

The Opportunity

We are working with an established construction business seeking a Business Development Executive to join its team based in St Albans.

This is an opportunity to join a growing business and play an important role in supporting its business development function, contributing to new business opportunities, tender submissions and client relationship management.

Working closely with the wider team, you will provide day-to-day administrative and operational support, assist with lead generation and help maintain a strong pipeline of future opportunities.

The role will also involve supporting the company's market presence through networking, industry engagement and client communication, helping to strengthen existing relationships and develop new ones.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Business Development team.
- Assist with identifying, developing and managing new business and tender opportunities.
- Support the preparation and submission of Pre-Qualification Questionnaires (PQQs) and Expressions of Interest (EOIs).
- Assist with pre-tender correspondence, documentation and document control.
- Manage tender portals, including uploads, downloads and general administration.
- Support compliance administration and maintain accurate records.
- Assist with client communication, correspondence and relationship management.
- Manage selected key client relationships under the direction of the Business Development team.
- Act as a point of contact for clients during defects periods where required.
- Support networking activities, industry events and company functions.
- Carry out post-contract follow-up calls and client satisfaction checks.

Skills & Experience
- Strong organisational and administrative skills.
- Good written and verbal communication abilities.
- High level of attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and SharePoint.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
- Professional and confident manner when dealing with clients and external stakeholders.
- Previous experience in business development, construction or a professional services environment would be advantageous.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Title: Business Development Executive - Financial Services

Location: Watford, Hertfordshire

Salary: £26,500 starting salary (£27,500 after probation) + Performance Incentives, OTE £35,000-£38,000

Job Type: Permanent, Full time, Office Based

Start date: Training starts Monday 30th November 2026

Build your career in business development and financial services

Confident communicator? Commercially minded? Ready for your next career move?

If you've worked in sales, business development, account management, recruitment, customer service, retail or hospitality, you may already have the skills we're looking for.

At Fortrade, you'll join as a Business Development Executive, working with clients who have already registered and shown an interest in our services.

You'll build professional relationships, understand client needs, introduce clients to our platform and products, and identify opportunities to develop those relationships.

This is not cold calling - You will be speaking with people who have already registered and shown an interest in our services.

Key responsibilities:

A few of the main day-to-day responsibilities:
- Speaking with clients who have already registered and shown an interest in Fortrade
- Building and developing professional client relationships
- Understanding client needs and communicating our platform and services clearly
- Supporting clients through the account-opening process
- Working towards individual and team performance targets
- Receiving ongoing coaching and developing communication and product knowledge

What we're looking for

You don't need a finance degree or previous financial markets experience.

We're looking for people who are:
- Confident and professional communicators
- Commercially aware and motivated by results
- Ambitious and keen to progress
- Resilient and comfortable working towards targets
- Coachable and willing to learn
- Good at building professional relationships
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Experience in sales, business development, recruitment, account management, customer service, retail, hospitality or financial services is welcome.

Build your career with Fortrade

This role gives you the opportunity to develop your skills within financial services and progress as your experience and performance grow.

There are opportunities to develop towards Senior Account Manager or Team Leader positions based on performance, development and business requirements.

We've seen people progress to Senior Account Manager in as little as four months.

What you'll get:
- £26,500 starting salary
- £27,500 after probation
- Performance incentives
- Earning potential of £35,000-£38,000 including base salary and performance incentives
- Fully paid training
- Ongoing coaching and development
- Annual salary increases
- Pension
- Free on-site parking
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Internal career progression opportunities

Training starts Monday 30th November 2026

Successful candidates from the initial interview stage will be invited to our one-week fully paid training programme.

You'll learn about the platform, products, communication and compliance while demonstrating your suitability for the role.

Training is part of the selection process, followed by a Final Interview.

Successful candidates will then join the team.

About Fortrade

Fortrade is a global CFD and Forex trading provider authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), FRN 609970.

The role operates in an execution-only environment and does not involve providing personal financial advice or making trading decisions for clients.

Ready for your next move?

If you're confident, ambitious and enjoy building relationships and working towards results, we'd like to hear from you.

Build your skills. Develop your career. Progress with Fortrade.

Apply now for the Business Development Executive position in Watford.

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with experience of: Account Manager, Business Development Manager, Client Account Manager, Customer Service Executive, Sales Account Manager, Sales Executive, Sales Consultant, Business Development Representative, Business Development Consultant, Account Executive, Client Relationship Executive, Recruitment Consultant, Recruitment Resourcer, Customer Success Executive may also be considered for this role.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Whether you re a graduate, on a sandwich year, or early in your career, if you ve got the right attitude, we ll give you the platform to succeed.

Sales Executive

Welwyn Garden City, AL7
£26,500 to £32,000 basic salary, depending on experience
Full-time, Permanent
Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5.15pm
No weekends or bank holiday working

Build a real career in sales, not just find a job

Barco is a well-established business with over 40 years experience supplying plumbing and heating merchants. This is a sales role built around long-standing customer relationships, warm enquiries and genuine career development.

You won t be thrown in at the deep end. You ll receive full training and ongoing support, working as part of a small, close-knit team that works closely with purchasing, external sales managers and management.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone who is confident, proactive and keen to build a long-term career in sales.

What s in it for you
- £26,500 to £32,000 basic salary, depending on experience
- Annual bonus, dependent on company and individual performance
- Monday to Friday working hours, 8.30am to 5.15pm
- No weekend or bank holiday working
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays after probation
- Life insurance at 3x salary
- Wellbeing support services, including 24-hour counselling and private GP access
- Free parking
- Short walk from Welwyn Garden City station and town centre bus services
- Full training and ongoing support
- Clear opportunity to progress into more senior sales roles
- Supportive, close-knit team environment

What you ll be doing

You ll be joining Barco s internal sales team, supporting established customers and helping to grow existing relationships.

Your role will include:
- Handling inbound enquiries and converting them into sales
- Contacting warm leads and building strong customer relationships
- Preparing quotes and following up to close deals
- Supporting customers across the plumbing and heating merchant sector
- Identifying opportunities to increase order value through upselling and cross-selling
- Working closely with purchasing, external sales managers and the wider team
- Taking ownership of your own performance and development

What we re looking for

You don t need to arrive as the finished article. Barco is more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, drive and willingness to learn.

You ll need to be:
- A confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills
- Self-motivated, proactive and keen to take ownership
- Positive, professional and willing to learn
- Comfortable speaking with customers and building relationships
- Driven by targets, results and career progression
- A team player who enjoys working in a busy, supportive environment

Previous sales, customer service or account management experience would be helpful, but it is not essential. Full training will be provided for the right person.

Why join Barco?

Barco is an established business with a strong reputation and over 40 years experience in its market. You ll be selling to plumbing and heating merchants, building on years of existing customer relationships rather than starting from scratch.

This is a great opportunity to join a stable, supportive business where you can learn quickly, develop your sales skills and progress your career based on performance.

Apply now

If you re looking for a sales role where you can learn, grow and be rewarded for your effort, we d love to hear from you.

Please note: applicants must have the right to work in the UK. No agencies.

This role may suit candidates with experience as:

Sales Executive, Junior Sales Executive, Graduate Sales Executive, Internal Sales Executive, Telesales Executive, Sales Advisor, Customer Sales Advisor, Sales Consultant, Account Executive, Customer Service Advisor.

title: Sales Executive - Mercedes-Benz Hemel Hempstead
description:
Sales Executive - Mercedes-Benz Hemel Hempstead

Salary £24,000 (uncapped earnings)

Fun, exciting, rewarding work. Join us for the ride.

Working with world-class brands as a Sales Executive you'll have the drive to deliver outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers.

As part of a successful, global automotive group, you'll broaden your experience across both sites and brands. And with the right support from us, you'll be able to progress as high as you can aim.

What we can offer you
- Enjoy 33 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) to rest and recharge
- Save money every day with our exclusive retail discounts
- Drive a great deal with discounts on new and used cars, plus servicing offers
- Plan for the years ahead with our company pension scheme
- Balance home and work with our industry-leading family-friendly policies designed to help you spend more time with the people that matter
- Commute for less with our cycle-to-work scheme
- Prioritise your wellbeing with dedicated support for you and your family
- 24/7 access to healthcare professionals, ensuring you get the expert advice you need quickly and easily
- Make a difference with a paid day to volunteer in your community
- Invest in your future with our company share purchase plan
- Earn financial rewards when you refer a friend to join the team
- Keep learning and growing with our training and development opportunities for everyone.
- Life assurance with the option to increase cover
- We're open to flexible working options - just ask

What you'll do day to day
- Guide customers through a seamless journey, from the initial welcome to negotiation and the handover of their purchased vehicle
- Actively prospect for new customers via telephone, attend product launches and events, and maintain a comprehensive enquiry database
- Maintain in-depth product knowledge and continuously enhance expertise through manufacturer-led training sessions
- Recommend suitable add-on products that align with customer needs and preferences
- Ensure the effective use of customer enquiry management systems for optimal tracking and follow-up
- Deliver outstanding customer service that fosters loyalty and encourages referrals

Helpful skills and qualifications

Don't worry about ticking off every single skill here if you care about delivering great experiences as much as we do, we want to hear from you.
- Previous experience in a sales or customer service role, demonstrating the ability to achieve targets and build relationships
- Ability to deliver first-class customer service with energy and enthusiasm
- A genuine interest in helping customers and contributing to the team's success
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines, with excellent attention to detail
- Exceptional listening and communication skills, focused on understanding customer needs
- Must hold a valid UK driving licence

We value diversity and believe it strengthens our team. If you don't meet every requirement listed but are enthusiastic about this role and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Be part of something big

Group 1 Automotive is on an exciting growth journey. We are home to over 7000 colleagues dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, with 114 dealerships in the UK, representing 21 brands at the forefront of automotive retail.

But you don't need to love cars to work with us - just need to share our mission to create outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers, our partners, and our people.

Our Values

At Group 1 Automotive we pride ourselves on our five core values that are incorporated in all we that do.

Respect - Integrity - Transparency - Teamwork - Professionalism

These are the principles that every member of our team lives by, whether that be business functions, customer interactions, how we interact with the local community and even how we view each other in the team.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Sales Representative

Food or FMCG experience would be an advantage, and we welcome applications from people with relevant experience in other sectors.

title: Customer Sales Account Manager (Home Care)
description:
Great care starts with a conversation.

Choosing care for yourself or someone you love can feel overwhelming. We're looking for someone who can make that first step easier, build trust quickly and turn genuine enquiries into lasting customer relationships.

Hales HomeCare supports people in their own homes, helping them to live safely, confidently and independently while maintaining their dignity, choices and everyday routines. Our care teams work within local communities, providing practical care, reassurance and companionship tailored around the individual.

This reflects our commitment to delivering compassionate, person-centred care, built around each individual's needs, choices and routines, and underpinned by the values that guide everything we do at Hales HomeCare.

We're now looking for an engaging and enthusiastic Customer Acquisition Manager to take central ownership of our self-funded customer journey, from the very first enquiry through to care commencing.

The role

This is a commercially focused, customer-led position where speed, empathy and confident follow-up really matter.

People enquiring about care are making an important decision at a difficult or unfamiliar time. You'll become their primary point of contact, taking the time to understand what they need, explaining how Hales HomeCare can help and guiding them through the process.

At the same time, you'll take ownership of each opportunity. You'll follow up proactively, understand what may be preventing someone from making a decision and confidently ask for the business when Hales is the right solution.

What you'll be doing

You'll manage new self-funded enquiries from initial contact through to conversion, including:
- Responding quickly to new enquiries
- Understanding care requirements, urgency and funding position
- Checking geography and local branch capacity
- Building rapport with individuals and their families
- Clearly explaining the Hales HomeCare service and proposition
- Arranging care assessments with the appropriate branch
- Ensuring enquiries are followed through promptly
- Following up after assessments and quotations
- Confidently asking for the business and converting enquiries into customers
- Maintaining contact with families who are still considering their options
- Re-engaging suitable dormant enquiries
- Recording and understanding reasons for lost business
- Monitoring enquiry and conversion performance by marketing source
- Working closely with the Marketing team to understand what's working and adapt campaigns where necessary
- Reporting monthly on conversion rates, customer acquisition and lost opportunities

What we're looking for

First and foremost, we're looking for someone who knows how to turn an enquiry into a customer without making the experience feel like a hard sell.

You'll ideally bring:
- Proven experience in sales, customer acquisition, enquiry conversion or business development
- A strong track record of following leads from initial enquiry through to successful conversion
- Excellent telephone communication and relationship-building skills
- The ability to build trust quickly
- Confidence discussing services, pricing and next steps
- A proactive approach to follow-up rather than waiting for customers to come back to you
- Natural tenacity and commercial awareness
- A warm, consultative and empathetic communication style
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Confidence working with targets, conversion data and performance measures
- The ability to work effectively across operational and Marketing teams
- Proven experience of working with digital CRM systems and data analytics

Experience within home care, health or social care would be a distinct advantage, but it isn't essential.

Our priority is finding someone with excellent sales and customer-conversion skills who understands that great selling starts with listening, understanding and building trust.

Why join Hales HomeCare?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important part of the Hales HomeCare customer journey and make a genuine commercial impact.

You'll sit at the centre of the relationship between prospective customers, their families, our local branches and Marketing, making sure that promising enquiries don't become missed opportunities.

You'll be directly rewarded for your successes and be part of the ongoing development of the Hales Group brand

And there's a bigger purpose behind the numbers.

Every successful conversation could ultimately help someone to remain independent in the place they call home, supported by care built around their individual needs.

If you're commercially minded, brilliant with people and know how to turn conversations into customers, we'd love to hear from you.
